description:
This role is for one of our clients 
 
 Compensation: $60–$120 per hour
 Location: Global – Fully Remote
 Employment Type: Independent Contractor
 Work Commitment: Approximately 15 hours per week
 Schedule: Flexible – Choose your preferred working days and hours, including weekends.
 About the Role
 We are looking for highly skilled Data Scientists, Machine Learning Practitioners, and Applied Mathematics Experts with a strong track record in competitive data science, particularly on Kaggle or similar competition platforms.
 In this role, you will leverage your competition experience, mathematical reasoning, and programming expertise to develop challenging technical tasks for AI training and evaluation. The focus is on creating problems that require genuine analytical thinking and robust implementation rather than solutions that simply appear plausible.
 Each task should include a reproducible execution environment, a verified reference solution, and reliable evaluation mechanisms to determine whether a solution is technically correct and complete.
 The ideal candidate combines strong competitive programming and data science skills with the ability to develop, test, debug, and independently validate complex solutions.
 Requirements 
 Key Responsibilities
 Build reproducible computational environments, prepare relevant datasets and dependencies, and implement reliable reference solutions.
 Design challenging data science and machine learning tasks that require strong analytical reasoning and practical implementation skills.
 Develop test cases, evaluation criteria, and verification mechanisms that distinguish correct solutions from incomplete, inaccurate, or flawed approaches.
 Execute coding agents against assigned tasks, analyse their outputs, investigate failures, and refine tasks based on observed performance.
 Identify implementation errors, incorrect assumptions, data leakage, methodological weaknesses, and other issues that may affect solution accuracy.
 Validate solutions through independent testing, computational experiments, and reproducible workflows.
 Document task requirements, solution methodologies, technical reasoning, and verification procedures clearly.
 Ensure that all tasks and reference solutions meet high standards of correctness, reliability, and reproducibility.
 Required Skills and Qualifications
 Expert rank or higher on Kaggle or a comparable competitive data science platform.
 Demonstrated experience participating in competitive data science, machine learning, or applied mathematics challenges.
 Strong understanding of data science methodologies, machine learning techniques, statistical analysis, and mathematical problem-solving.
 Ability to explain the reasoning behind selected approaches, algorithms, and implementation decisions.
 Practical programming proficiency sufficient to independently develop, implement, test, and verify solutions.
 Experience building reproducible workflows and evaluating technical solutions against defined criteria.
 Strong analytical thinking, debugging skills, and attention to detail.
 Relevant Competition Platforms
 Experience with one or more of the following platforms is highly relevant:
 Kaggle
 DrivenData
 Zindi
 AIcrowd
 Numerai
 DataSource.ai
 CodaLab / Codabench
 Preferred Skills and Additional Advantages
 Strong hands-on coding experience, particularly in Python.
 Proficiency in testing, debugging, and troubleshooting complex implementations.
 Ability to navigate unfamiliar codebases, understand existing workflows, and implement solutions efficiently.
 Experience with Python-based data science and machine learning libraries.
 Familiarity with automated evaluation, benchmarking, and reproducibility practices.
 Experience working with coding agents or AI-assisted development tools.
 Engagement Details
 Compensation: $60–$120 per hour.
 Location: Global – Fully Remote.
 Employment Type: Independent Contractor.
 Work Commitment: Approximately 15 hours per week.
 Schedule: Flexible working hours, with the option to work on weekends.
